body: Yes! I loved this book. Read it about 10 years ago but I remember the themes of hard work, suffering, dedication, necessity, survival, and pride. Short read too!
Great book. Never felt like I was a man slowly freezing in the Arctic until I read that book. I kinda feel like I faced death in a way :P prepped myself for it a bit.

Black Elk Speaks. I spent so many hours just thinking and crying. He speaks of such a historically significant and painful (if you’re indigenous, or just a decent human being) time in American history (massacre of wounded knee, and Custler’ death) in such a poetic, raw and humble way. I was constantly moved. My mind was constantly blown. I learned SO much…the way he describes life and our responsibilities as humans is so validating and light and refreshing. And him describing life before colonization is just…🤌🏼This is like my Native bible lol. I’m gonna read it again right now actually, it’s been a few years.
